_note: Stand-in for a model response, written for the offline demo and to test the pipeline without an API key. Not model output.
_about: Written against docs/HARNESS.md. Across the four canned cards the tests cover the verdicts accepted, proves-nothing, fails-on-clean and rejected, plus an untestable criterion. Flaky and not-built-yet need a nondeterministic app or a card outside Done, so tests/taskgen/test_gate.py covers them. Keys that start with an underscore are notes for readers and are dropped before validation.

tests.name: test_unverified_caller_gets_a_reply
tests.intent: Fails if Front Desk says nothing to an unverified caller who asks about an appointment.
tests._why: Deliberately weak: it checks only that a reply exists, so it passes whatever Front Desk says.

tests.name: test_verified_caller_hears_their_own_next_appointment
tests.intent: Fails if a verified caller is not confirmed or hears an appointment other than their own.

tests.name: test_verified_caller_hears_the_appointment_time
tests.intent: Fails if a verified caller asking later is not told the time of their next appointment.
tests._why: Deliberate mistake: it expects '9:00 AM', but the guide says a time on the hour is spoken '9 AM'. The test is wrong, not the app.

tests.name: test_date_of_birth_in_another_form_verifies
tests.intent: Fails if a date of birth said in words or as 3/3/80 does not verify the caller.

tests.name: test_three_failed_attempts_stop_and_offer_a_transfer
tests.intent: Fails if a third failed verification attempt asks again instead of stopping, offering a transfer and flagging the call.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import TRANSFER_OFFER, VERIFY_LOCKED


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-2/AC-4")
def test_three_failed_attempts_stop_and_offer_a_transfer(call):
    call.say("My name is Maria Alvarez, born January 1st 1990.")
    call.say("My name is Maria Alvarez, born January 2nd 1990.")
    reply = call.say("My name is Maria Alvarez, born January 3rd 1990.")

    assert reply.text == f"{VERIFY_LOCKED} {TRANSFER_OFFER}"
    assert "verification_failed" in call.record()["flags"]

tests.name: test_verified_caller_hears_nothing_about_another_patient
tests.intent: Fails if a verified caller asking about another patient hears that patient's appointment.
tests._why: A correct test that no seeded bug breaks: the catalog has no mistake on this path, so the gate cannot show it can fail.
